text:
jordan: Customer S-1843 reports 5xx spike and timeouts hitting hosted inference during a tenant surge. Getting lots of 502/504s from gateway.

sara: seeing same in dashboards — queue depth jumped and tokens per request spiked. Spike started ~10:14 UTC.

mike: can you paste the gateway logs around 10:14? suspect scale-up lag + warm init.

support-jess: attached customer repro steps: repeated gen requests with concurrency 60, seq len ~1k. They used our public API key (customer token) -> started failing after ~2m.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: kustomize/autoscaler-config rolled out by @mike at 09:58 UTC — change: keda.pollInterval=5s -> 10s, activationThreshold=30 -> 60

mike: that rollout touched the scaledobject annotations and HPA thresholds. I reverted part of it earlier but the rollout window overlapped peak.

jordan: logs: model-init timeouts on new pods: "model fetch timeout after 120s" and readiness probe flapped.

oncall-sre: dump of a failing pod log:
```
[2026-03-17T10:15:02Z] INFO loading model: gpt-small-v1
[2026-03-17T10:16:58Z] WARN model init failed: rpc timeout
[2026-03-17T10:17:00Z] ERROR readiness: false, prewarm_cache_miss=true
```

sara: hpa minReplicas was 0 for that node pool; KEDA activation thresholds now require more sustained load (activationThreshold=60) so scaling delayed. Combined: slow model init + delayed activation -> queue backlog -> gateway timeouts.

support-jess: customer sees ~80% errors on requests that hit cold replicas only. If they retry after 40s success rate improves.

mike: repro locally: run this script hitting the tenant in stage for 60 concurrent clients for 90s.
```
for i in {1..60}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hi"}' $ENDPOINT &
done
wait
```
observed: request latencies climb, new pods created but remain NotReady for ~70-90s.

jordan: root cause hypothesis:
- KEDA annotation change increased activation window -> slower scale-up
- HPA minReplicas=0 leads to cold starts
- model init/warmcache takes ~60-90s on our images under heavy IO
- gateway/client timeouts still at 30-40s, causing 502/504s

oncall-sre: immediate mitigations:
- rollback the autoscaler rollout OR patch scaledobject activationThreshold back to 30 (in-flight)
- bump HPA minReplicas to 2 for tenant pools temporarily
- increase gateway timeout to 120s (temporary) to avoid return 502s while pods warm

mike: applied a hotfix: scaledobject.activationThreshold=30 at 10:32 UTC, increased minReplicas to 2 at 10:34 UTC. Gateways set to 90s at 10:36 UTC.

ops-bot: patch-applied: scaledobject/tenant-pool patched by @mike
ops-bot: hpa/tenant-pool updated by @mike

sara: after patches, queue depth returned to normal within ~2m, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 0.7% for the tenant. Customer confirmed partial recovery.

support-jess: customer updated: they saw errors taper off after we bumped minReplicas. They want permanent fix and postmortem.

mike: follow-ups to do:
- add a prewarm image with smaller cold-init (optimize model download + local cache)
- add a readiness probe change to mark pod NotServing until KV cache primed
- refine KEDA tunables per workload (activationThreshold, cooldown) and create canary before changing globally
- add auto-increase of gateway timeout for first 2 minutes when new pod pool is scaling

jordan: I'll open a postmortem ticket and include repro steps, metrics slices, and timeline. tagging @oncall-sre for SLO impact analysis.

oncall-sre: noted. assign severity P2, SLA noise, need to validate if any other tenants affected.

support-jess: customer asks for a config recommendation to avoid this: suggested prod config: minReplicas >=1 for critical tenants, KEDA activationThreshold <=30 for bursty workloads, and prefer a warmpool for high-traffic tenants.

mike: creating a short-run runbook: 1) check scaledobject annotations 2) check minReplicas 3) roll patch to reduce activationThreshold 4) temporarily raise gateway timeout 5) monitor queue depth and readiness

sara: adding dashboards to surface "prewarm_miss" and "model_init_seconds" per pool.

jordan: closing loop: will schedule retrospective and postmortem doc. thanks team. :thumbsup:
